verdict.rationale: Evidence only gestures at general extensibility (rich APIs, customizable fields/workflows, 3000+ marketplace integrations) but never documents a design/UI framework (e.g., Forge UI kit, dashboard gadget SDK) that lets a designer build custom views or widgets matching Jira's native look-and-feel. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Forge/Connect UI components, dashboard gadget API, design system/theming guidelines, and any hands-on evidence of designers successfully building native-feeling widgets.
